headline: The expensive verify tier is dominated by both cheaper tiers on this corpus: Hy4-preview at $0.0068/audit delivers 57.1% BAD recall and 55.6% false-BAD on CLEAN, vs the $0.0121 battery's 71.4%/30.2% and the earned loop's 81.8% at $0.00034/finding. The r13 pointer's premise (economics flip when the expensive tier is actually expensive) is VOID at the quality axis: price does not buy adjudication here. The r13 standing decision (battery as triage hint, earned loop as the middle rung) SURVIVES the re-price.
